In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] members [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Merinda Niemeh]] used a '''freighter''' to infiltrate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]]. The two-person [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had originally been stolen by [[Eyrie Base]]'s [[Red Team (Eyrie Base)|Red Team]] on [[Ongella]].
